question.description: The single quiz question to ask. ONE question per turn: ask, then end your turn — the answer determines the next question.

label.description: Display label for the answer option — a bare claim, no reasoning

value.description: Optional machine-readable value returned for the option. Defaults to the label.

options.description: REQUIRED. The answer options (2 or more) as a JSON ARRAY of option objects — never a JSON-encoded string. Options only — there is no free-text mode. Give each option a stable `value`; you reference the correct one by that value in correctAnswer. Never add your own 'I don't know' option — that choice is added for you.

multiSelect.description: Set to true when more than one option is correct and the learner must select all of them.

explanation.description: REQUIRED. Explanation revealed AFTER the learner answers (shown whether they got it right or wrong). Use it to reinforce why the correct answer is correct. It is written BEFORE correctAnswer by design: reason it out first, then commit the answer the reasoning supports.

correctAnswer.description: REQUIRED. The correct answer as the option value(s) — the `value` field of the option you intend. Single-select: a single string (e.g. "mercury"). Multi-select: an array of strings (e.g. ["belize", "niue"]); the learner is only correct if their selection matches this set exactly. Always pass the value, not a position number — this is self-checking and prevents miscounting. A value that matches no option fails validation and the call is returned to you to fix.

details.description: Optional extra context or instructions shown under the question.

type.description: REQUIRED — the question's role in the teaching cycle, as a bare word (no quotes): predict = posed BEFORE you teach the step (its own turn; the learner answers, then your teaching resolves it — arrives open, never collapsed); check = posed AFTER the step's teaching is complete (arrives collapsed behind the Check your understanding reveal). ONE question per turn either way.

nodeId.description: REQUIRED plan-tree node id this question is about — must EXACTLY match one of this session's plan_init node slugs (validated at call time; a mismatched id is rejected back to you). The lesson's position on the map derives from these tags (the node the latest tagged question is about is where the map stands; earlier ones count as visited). A node takes as many questions as it deserves: stay on one node for as many turns as the understanding needs — one reasoning step at a time, never rush forward. For off-map checks use ask_user_question.

details.description: Optional extra context or instructions shown under the question.

question.description: The single question to ask the learner. ONE question per turn: ask, then end your turn — the answer determines the next question.

details.description: Optional extra context or instructions shown under the question.

label.description: Display label for the answer option — a bare claim, no reasoning

value.description: Optional machine-readable value returned for the option. Defaults to the label.

description.description: Optional extra detail shown below the option

options.description: Optional multiple-choice options. Omit for free-form text input. The learner can always choose 'Other' and type a custom answer when options are provided.

multiSelect.description: Set to true to allow multiple answers to the same question.

strand.description: The dependency strand (e.g. 'the derivative as a limit') — a name the plan can hang a node on.

assessment.description: Where his edge sits on this strand: the floor (what he reliably gets right), the ceiling (where it runs out), misconceptions found, and what the lesson should build from.

strands.description: Every strand the planned lesson will depend on, each with your read of his edge on it.

summary.description: Optional overall synthesis: his apparent goal and where the teaching should enter.

assessment.description: The learner assessment — the probe's distilled output.
